query: SELECT ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN p.price>60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),1) FROM products p JOIN reviews r USING(category,ref_id) WHERE p.category='electronics' AND r.year IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.ref_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT r.user_id)>=3
columns: ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN p.price>60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),1)
